title: Sculpting the hidden layer
description: A sculptor shapes the hidden layer while TensorQuill is a work in progress.
alt: A sculptor uses a hammer and chisel to shape the hidden layer of a neural network; work in progress, made with Manim.

requirements.description: Create a compact, looping work-in-progress GIF made with Manim for the README. Show a recognizable sculptor holding a hammer and chisel, shaping rough stone into the hidden-layer nodes of a neural network. Include the labels Work in progress, Hidden layer, and Made with Manim. Use a white background, readable Arial-family text, and a steady canvas. This is a construction metaphor, not a numerical network simulation.
A looping 960x400 GIF at approximately 15 fps, under 5 MB, plus a valid PNG thumbnail.
Use Arial-family text and a white background. Include Work in progress, Hidden layer, and Made with Manim; no mathematical text is required.
